C1.claim: the unchanged model reads its known Pile values
C1.rule: first, alone: W0 under the Pile harness (256 Pile val rows, 20-step adversary, adversary seeds 0, 1, 2), faith_score.w0_check, as E34. Expected: pass, floor about 0.075 on an H100. Fails: stop, nothing trained

G1.claim: the emoticon LoRA teacher reproduces E27's H100 regeneration
G1.rule: the emoticon LoRA teacher, before any student: at step 1000 its held-out P(target) within 0.001 of 0.99992, KL elsewhere within 0.001 of 0.01625, size (rel_norm_max) within 0.001 of 0.11968: E27's regeneration of the same recipe on an H100 (lora_sgd.json evals.adam['1000']), which the first run of this amendment reproduced to 1e-9. E9's own factors on an L40S read 0.9999 / 0.0048 / 0.0900 and their adjoint state kept P 0.063 (E14); the first filing gated on those and stopped at 11:13 (results/predictions_amend3_filed-1050_g1-e9.json). The in-job adjoint state's P(target) is reported beside E14's 0.063, not gated. Fails: stop with the three numbers

task_gate.claim: every LoRA teacher learnt its task
task_gate.rule: per task, after its teacher's reading: a LoRA teacher with held-out P(target) < 0.9 at step 1000 is reported (its reading, gap, do-nothing and adjoint states) and its arms skipped; the run goes on to the next task. A skip, not a stop: r0 and r1 have no LoRA reference

P1.claim: the task-text copy passes at both steps on every learnt task
P1.rule: arm A student of each task whose LoRA teacher learnt (P(target) >= 0.9 at step 1000): state_verdict 'pass' and held-out P(target) >= 0.9 at step 100 and at step 1000

P2.claim: on emoticon the task-text copy keeps 0.5 more P(target) than the adjoint split
P2.rule: emoticon: the step-1000 arm-A student's held-out P(target) minus the LoRA's scaled adjoint state's held-out P(target) in this job (E14: 0.063), absolute

P3.claim: the Pile-text copy learns every task (lean)
P3.rule: arm B student of each task whose LoRA teacher learnt, at step 1000: held-out P(target) and state_verdict; category per task as Amendment 1's P1: 'learnt' (P >= 0.9 and 'pass'), 'neither' (P < 0.5), 'between' (anything else); overall 'learnt' if every such task is, 'neither' if every one is, else 'between'
